setup.text: While the dough freezes, preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).

operations.label: mix
operations.text: Mix the white sugar, jaggery and salt together.

operations.label: brown
operations.text: Brown the butter until it bubbles and froths, then settles.

operations.label: mix until homogenous
operations.text: Mix the browned butter into the sugar and salt until it's homogenous.

operations.label: mix until homogenous
operations.text: Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix until homogenous.

operations.label: mix to a rough dough
operations.text: Add the flour and baking soda and mix until you get a rough dough.

operations.label: break into medium pieces
operations.text: Break the chocolate into medium-sized pieces.

operations.label: mix in
operations.text: Mix the chocolate chunks into the dough.

operations.label: roll into small balls
operations.text: Take the dough out and roll it into small balls.

operations.label: move to a steel tray, shape gently
operations.text: Take the cookies out, move them to a steel tray or plate and shape them gently.

operations.label: cool completely
operations.text: Let them cool completely so they hold their shape.
